scenarios.name: pumps-per-named-creature-any-controller
scenarios.why: Relentless Rats counts each OTHER creature on the battlefield named Relentless Rats regardless of controller: with two on the opponent's side, p0's sees two and is 4/4, and each of p1's sees two and is 4/4.

scenarios.name: base-with-no-other-named-creature
scenarios.why: A lone Relentless Rats has no other creature named Relentless Rats, so it stays its printed 2/2.

scenarios.name: differently-named-rat-does-not-count
scenarios.why: The pump keys on the exact name Relentless Rats, not the Rat subtype: a Rat Colony beside it does not pump it (2/2), while Rat Colony does count the Relentless Rats as an other Rat (2/1 + 1/+0 = 3/1).
